name: R Aqr

paper.title: Visible-light High-contrast Imaging and Polarimetry with SCExAO/VAMPIRES

notes: R Aqr: nearest symbiotic binary (M7III Mira + accreting white dwarf, P_orb~44 yr) with a precessing jet and an extended H-alpha emission nebula. Distance 386 pc adopted from Gaia (plx 2.59 mas), consistent with the 0.13 arcsec = 50 au scale of Lucas et al. 2024. Added 2026-07-09 via Miles Lucas VAMPIRES instrument paper.
